hooks.command: git -c "alias.chock-hook=!test -f .chock/bin/launch.sh || { echo chock: no .chock/bin/launch.sh here, run chock sync --repo . >&2; exit 2; }; sh .chock/bin/launch.sh" chock-hook .chock/bin/codex_cli.py --gate ".chock/compiled/scan-secrets/pre-tool-use/gate.json"
hooks.commandWindows: & git -c "alias.chock-hook=!test -f .chock/bin/launch.sh || { echo chock: no .chock/bin/launch.sh here, run chock sync --repo . >&2; exit 2; }; sh .chock/bin/launch.sh" chock-hook .chock/bin/codex_cli.py --gate ".chock/compiled/scan-secrets/pre-tool-use/gate.json"; if ($null -eq $LASTEXITCODE) { exit 2 }; exit $LASTEXITCODE
